desc: 大袋结团粘土猫砂的白底主图、图标栅格、痛点、场景、微距与信任九镜套图
name: 大袋结团粘土猫砂多猫家庭款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用整袋直立剪影交代品类与分量感。
一秒把核心卖点结构化讲完，用四格空版图标栅格承接主图后的第一屏说服。
放大扬尘、带出砂盆、角落脏乱的真实烦恼，让买家先对号入座再看方案。
把产品放进真实养猫家里的清晨一刻，让多猫家庭代入自己的使用画面。
用颗粒与结团的微距质感替产品做实证，回答好不好铲会不会散。
保留双栏对照的说服结构，让落尘与结团的差异自己说话，主张位一律留空。
把袋身比例与参数疑问一次答清，用空参数条替买家留出对照空间。
用三格侧视连环讲清铺设、清理、补砂的用法，降低上手门槛并暗示耐用节奏。
以品牌棚拍质感收口降风险，空印章框承接买家的最后一道信任确认。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the macro and spec screens, warm light-grey field #F1EFEA for the info and how-to screens, deep lake-blue panel #1F7BC0 for the pain and trust screens; one flat panel per frame, no scenery drift
style.direction: clean clinical pet-care commerce, lake-blue and paper-white retail packshot system with light infographic scaffolding
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icon plates in deep lake-blue #1F7BC0 on white circles, kept deliberately glyph-free, one sunny yellow accent #F2C230 for markers only
style.lightingSystem: cool-neutral high-key studio light, broad front-left key plus white fill card, soft contact shadows that always ground the bag, no hard speculars; lifestyle scenes switch to 5500K window light from the left while keeping the same shadow direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm light-grey field #F1EFEA, deep lake-blue panel #1F7BC0 and one sunny yellow accent #F2C230; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key, white fill card and soft grounding contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif kept as blank caption bars in this detached set; consistent thin single-weight line icon plates left glyph-free; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and fixed product scale; matte pale oak floor #D9B183 only in lifestyle scenes; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numerals, no badges or star strips.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or shadow direction
no rendered words, numerals, percentages or units anywhere
no platform badges, star strips or social-proof ribbons
style.presentationRules: the tall sealed bag keeps one stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, constant scale and constant edge clearance across the set; animals appear only as generic pets whose identity is irrelevant; every proof element stays an empty plate rather than a claim
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale oak floor #D9B183 in lifestyle scenes only; seamless paper-white and warm light-grey boards #F1EFEA on every packshot, macro, comparison and spec screen; shallow white tray rims as the recurring stage prop
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif hierarchy reserved as blank caption bars and empty plate layouts; in this detached set every letter slot stays empty so any seller copy can be dropped in later
